file_stem: RWB E1 001 Recovery tables for the 14 data products
title: Recovery tables for the 14 data products
goal: Create the 92 recovery tables, the data dictionary and the 14-product catalog
why: Every later story builds on these tables. No copy of ACE data: links to ACE are varchar(255) business keys, never foreign keys into public.
triggers: Flyway V0001 in the ACE pipeline
ace_note: Reads no view. V0001 pre-seeds dictionary rows for all 30 v_ace_* views (304 fields); the views themselves ship in E1-069.

writes.note: 88 Workbench + 4 extension tables keyed by ACE business key
14 rows DP01-DP14, one owner and system of record each
1,366 field rows with BR Field IDs
one view that answers 'what is this field?'

stores: Append-only triggers on decision_log_entry and interaction. 20 old copy/load tables are not created (loan_account, party, load_run, dq_rule ...).
rules: BR3: one system of record per product, written like 'ACE (ingested from ALS)', plus one owner
BR5: a bare source name such as 'CCMS' is refused
BR8: no copy of source data, no FK into public; ACE links are varchar(255) business keys
BR9: V0001 seeds dictionary rows for the 30 views before the views exist
risks: Catalog row with no owner, or a bare system of record -> whole load refused (MSG-P1-003)
Same file loaded twice -> nothing written (MSG-P1-011)
example: SELECT * FROM v_data_dictionary WHERE entity = 'v_ace_account' AND field = 'days_past_due'
-> product DP01 | 'ACE (ingested from ALS)' | DAILY | owner RW-DATASTEW
account_ext.dispute_open -> DF-EXT-028 | BOOLEAN | source Workbench | DP01
